name: Residents below the poverty line
source: Census Reporter city profile, reproducing U.S. Census Bureau 2024 ACS 5-year poverty estimate for Carmel-by-the-Sea
notes: The directly opened profile identifies ACS 2024 5-year and reports 6.2% ±3.6 percentage points (195 ±113 people) below poverty for Carmel-by-the-Sea, GEOID 0611250. name: Unemployment rate (ACS five-year estimate)
unit: % of civilian labor force, population 16 years and over
source: Census Reporter API, republishing U.S. Census Bureau ACS 2024 5-year table B23025
notes: Exact geography 16000US0611250, Carmel-by-the-Sea; ACS 2020–2024 5-year release, B23025 universe population age 16+. Table estimate is 56 unemployed of 1,780 civilian labor-force participants, 56 ÷ 1,780 = 3.146%, rounded to 3.1%. The table's MOEs are ±51 unemployed and ±411 civilian labor force; the rate therefore has substantial uncertainty and this five-year ACS estimate is not directly comparable to the previous county annual BLS 2025 series. Tier 1 local city searches did not locate a city unemployment series. Official Census city API access failed; the Census Reporter API is a tier-3 secondary interface to the ACS data, with captured response metadata and MOEs.
